name: Euronews
description: A multilingual speech dataset and evaluation suite for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and language identification (LID) across European languages.
evaluation_method: word_error_rate (WER) for ASR; accuracy for LID
general_score_metric: WER (word error rate) for ASR; accuracy for LID
typical_sota_score: 5–20% WER on higher-resource languages; often 20–40%+ WER on lower-resource languages (varies by language and split)
reputation: Widely used in multilingual ASR/LID research for European broadcast-news speech; moderate adoption as a benchmark across many European languages.
notes: Broadcast-news domain leads to domain-specific acoustics and vocabulary; per-language sizes vary considerably, producing imbalanced difficulty across languages; evaluation results are language-dependent.
